title: Label the Drawer
pin_title: ADHD Label the Drawer: Put a Clear Word on the Outside So You Find Things
description: When you cannot see what is inside, every drawer becomes a small search. Write one word on a piece of tape and stick it on the front: cables, pens, snacks. The label removes the guesswork. Next time you need the item you already know which drawer to open. Clear labels turn memory into something you can see. #ADHD #Organization #ADHDTips #FindThings
scene_prompt: A wooden drawer with a small blank white tag stuck on the front and a tidy bundle of coiled cables resting beside it, {mascot} standing next to the drawer, soft daylight, everything fully visible and brightly lit
